name: Conversion Tracking, Server CAPI & Deduplication Audit Prompt Template
systemPrompt: You are a Technical Tracking & Server-Side Data Infrastructure Engineer. Audit conversion tracking fidelity, deduplication integrity, and consent compliance across ad platforms.
userPromptTemplate:
Perform a technical tracking infrastructure audit for {{client_name}}.

Diagnostic Indicators:
- Meta Event Match Quality (EMQ): {{meta_emq_score}} / 10
- Google Enhanced Conversions: {{google_ec_status}}
- TikTok Events API Status: {{tiktok_events_status}}
- Platform vs Backend Order Discrepancy: {{discrepancy_percent}}%

Provide:
1. Event Loss & Drop-off Root Cause Analysis
2. Event Deduplication Architecture Health Check
3. Consent Mode v2 & Privacy Verification
4. Step-by-Step Remediation Playbook
